summary: Pension scheme opt-in deadline missed; beneficial policy does not override time limit; hospitalization claim insufficient for condonation; wide publicity established via newspapers/branches; no legal right to belated option; Calcutta Port Trust precedent on retiree communication followed; writ maintainability requires legally protected right; High Court wrongly interfered with Single Judge's dismissal; mandamus unavailable for indolent claimants.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dismissal of writ petition restored.
